os: Linux vm 6.18.5-fc-v20 #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC x86_64 GNU/Linux
model_provider_configuration: none -- Veyra calls no LLM anywhere in this codebase, by design. This benchmark exercises only Veyra's static analysis (Phase 2.1-2.8) and retrieval (Phase 4.1-4.7) pipelines. Runtime execution (M3) is not exercised because no Docker daemon is reachable in this environment.
clone_method: git clone --depth 1 (shallow, single commit -- sufficient since this benchmark evaluates static+retrieval analysis of one snapshot per repo, not git history/regression features)

repositories.name: fastapi
repositories.note: file count includes docs_src/ example snippets, not just the fastapi/ package itself

repositories.name: django
repositories.note: file count includes django/ package, tests/, and docs example code

reproduction_instructions: git clone --depth 1 <url> <local_path> && cd <local_path> && git checkout <commit_sha> (with --depth 1 the shallow clone already lands on the pinned commit above at clone time; re-running later will pick up a different HEAD unless the SHA is fetched explicitly, e.g. `git fetch --depth 1 origin <commit_sha> && git checkout <commit_sha>`).
